result.title: Dense Endoluminal Mapping and Localisation from Monocular Bronchoscopy
result.summary: Bronchoscopy inserts a camera through the airways to diagnose endoluminal disease. Locating the camera along the airway usually requires additional equipment, such as an electromagnetic tracker and a preoperative CT scan. In this paper, we investigate the use of the monocular camera stream to localise the bronchoscope without requiring additional sensing. We introduce a monocular SLAM system that localises the tip of a bronchoscope and reconstructs the airway surface around it from RGB video alone. A Depth Anything 3 backbone, fine-tuned on over a million photorealistic airway renderings, returns metric per-pixel depth and is the system's only source of scale. DINOv3 features routed through a custom cross-attention matcher supply sub-pixel correspondences on mucosa where classical descriptors fail. Both enter a factor graph alongside a dense constraint from projective iterative closest point (ICP) registration against the system's own running reconstruction, so surface evidence stabilises the directions the visual factors leave weakly observable. On six airways rendered from patient CT scans, the system reaches 26.1 mm mean absolute trajectory error and 77.5% mean surface F-score. Its mean surface accuracy exceeds that of five recent monocular SLAM and feed-forward baselines. MASt3R-SLAM, which fits a free scale to the ground truth, has a lower mean trajectory error (22.0 mm). ORB-SLAM3 completes only two of the six airways, whereas our system completes all six and also reconstructs two ex vivo specimens.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个仅用单目 RGB 视频的支气管镜 SLAM 系统：微调 Depth Anything 3 提供逐像素度量深度与唯一尺度来源，DINOv3 特征经自定义交叉注意力匹配器在黏膜上给出亚像素对应，并与投影 ICP 点云配准的稠密约束一起进入因子图；在六个 CT 渲染气道及两个离体标本上评估定位与表面重建精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把深度先验、注意力匹配与几何配准三类互补证据在因子图中融合、并用表面证据稳定「视觉因子弱可观测方向」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、状态更新与不确定性分配提供可核查的方法线索。
